metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Sindh province, Pakistan increase in September 21, 2020 compared to September 21, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sindh province, Pakistan (need to define geometry) - Dates: September 21, 2019 vs September 21, 2020 - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection, or use Sentinel-2 water indices like NDWI/MNDWI - I'll use Sentinel-1 SAR data as it's cloud-independent and good for water detection 2. Masking strategy: - For water detection, I need to identify water pixels using SAR backscatter (VV or VH polarization) - Water has low backscatter values (typically < -15 dB) - No cloud masking needed for SAR data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero (B): Water extent decreased (fewer water pixels in 2020) - Valid Positive (A): Water extent increased (more water pixels in 2020) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN/invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Sindh province geometry (approximate boundaries) const sindh = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[67.0, 23.5], [71.0, 23.5], [71.0, 28.5], [67.0, 28.5], [67.0, 23.5]] ]); // Define date ranges (±15 days window for better data availability) const date2019_start = '2019-09-14'; const date2019_end = '2019-09-28'; const date2020_start = '2020-09-14'; const date2020_end = '2020-09-28'; // Load Sentinel-1 SAR data const s1_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(sindh) .filterDate(date2019_start, date2019_end) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const s1_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(sindh) .filterDate(date2020_start, date2020_end) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size2019 = s1_2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = s1_2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Create median composites const img2019 = s1_2019.median(); const img2020 = s1_2020.median(); // Detect water (VV < -15 dB indicates water) const water2019 = img2019.lt(-15); const water2020 = img2020.lt(-15); // Calculate water extent (sum of water pixels) const extent2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sindh, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('VV'); const extent2020 = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sindh, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('VV'); // Calculate pixel counts to check validity const count2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sindh, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('VV'); const waterExtent2019 = extent2019.getInfo(); const waterExtent2020 = extent2020.getInfo(); const pixelCount2019 = count2019.getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${waterExtent2019}`); console.log(`2020 Water Pixels: ${waterExtent2020}`); console.log(`Total Pixels Analyzed: ${pixelCount2019}`); if (pixelCount2019 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (waterExtent2019 === null || waterExtent2020 === null || isNaN(waterExtent2019) || isNaN(waterExtent2020)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const difference = waterExtent2020 - waterExtent2019; const percentChange = ((difference / waterExtent2019) * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${difference} pixels (${percentChange}%)`); if (waterExtent2020 > waterExtent2019) { console.log('Surface water extent INCREASED in 2020.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Surface water extent did NOT increase in 2020.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
